title: Inferred rule
description: A rule an agent or its operators stated in prose, quoted with its source, and tracked until it is enforced in code.

Quote.description: The rule exactly as written in the source. Never paraphrased or softened.

Tool.description: How the quote was found, e.g. Read or Grep.

Parameters.description: Source location as '<path> (L<start>[-<end>])', optionally prefixed with 'owner/repo:'.

Outcome.description: What the rule governs and whether code enforces it.

Status.description: Where the rule is in the five-step method. Defaults to prose-only.

PR.description: Pull request that enforces the rule.
